==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
In this world there are mages, ninjas, and superhumans. All three have a somewhat secret existence. But all three have some awareness of each other.

I am a superhuman who is attending a mage academy. I am hiding my superhuman abilities from my fellow students. I am super strong, extremely durable, and I can fly.

I accidentally fly into the wrong territory. I am confronted by ninjas and superhuman criminals. While I am stronger and faster than the ninjas, I am unable to escape one of the superhuman criminals who is even stronger than me.
